backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder for backend functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single high-confidence feature to change crate keys pricing text from '$5' to '$0.11' in ShopInfoSection.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing components, styling, animations, and theme system for the HellCod MC Lifesteal website.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme CSS custom properties for colors, borders, shadows, and design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with basic meta tags, title, and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component wrapping all sections with ThemeProvider and rendering custom cursor, effects, header, and page sections with proper z-index layering.
frontend/src/components/CallToAction.tsx: Call-to-action section with scroll animations, glassmorphic cards promoting server join, Discord link, and fresh server launch notice.
frontend/src/components/CloudsBackground: Empty file placeholder for clouds background component.
frontend/src/components/CustomCursor.tsx: Custom cursor component with morphism-inspired design that detects touch devices, tracks mouse position, and responds to hover/click states with blend modes.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying server info, Discord link, copyright, and caffeine.ai attribution with responsive grid layout and theme-aware styling.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Gallery section with scroll-triggered animations displaying server builds using ImageSlideshow component (currently removed from main App).
Gameplay section showcasing four feature cards (Combat, Hearts, Competitive, Strategic) with scroll-based fade-in animations and glassmorphic styling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile menus, theme toggle, and Discord link. Includes smooth scrolling to page sections and responsive mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with animated title, server IP copy-to-clipboard card, and magnetic hover effect on Discord button with ripple animations. Includes auto-reveal animations and glassmorphic styling.
frontend/src/components/ImageSlideshow.t: Auto-advancing image carousel with navigation arrows, dot indicators, and transition animations. Displays 4 gallery images with 5-second intervals and manual controls.
frontend/src/components/IntroSequence.ts: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/Moon.tsx: Renders a fixed-position glowing moon element in the top-right area, only visible in dark theme mode.
frontend/src/components/MouseLightEffect: Creates a radial gradient light effect that follows the mouse cursor using requestAnimationFrame for smooth performance. Only active in dark theme.
frontend/src/components/RewardsSection.t: Displays server rewards, achievements, and statistics in animated cards with scroll-triggered fade-in effects. Shows top player rewards, seasonal events, and player stats.
Shop section displaying premium items and crate keys with pricing, descriptions, and a notice directing users to Discord for purchases. Uses scroll-triggered animations.
frontend/src/components/SiteLogo.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/Stars.tsx: Generates 70 randomly positioned twinkling star elements with varying sizes and animation timings, only visible in dark theme mode.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: A button component that toggles between light and dark themes, displaying animated sun/moon icons and optional 'Day'/'Night' text labels with accessibility features.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider for theme management that persists theme preference to localStorage and applies theme classes to the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Comprehensive Internet Identity authentication hook and provider that manages login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file intended for React Query hooks when backend functionality is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when an element becomes visible in the viewport for scroll-based animations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global styles with Tailwind directives, defining comprehensive OKLCH color system for light/dark themes with purple accent colors, gradient backgrounds, and custom cursor utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color tokens using OKLCH color space, purple theme colors, typography plugins, and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking one existing feature to update crate keys pricing from '$5' to '$0.11' in ShopInfoSection component.
